第25章 为贪狼皇父亲治病（第1页）
而且我们找了很多丹师前来查看。都没有用，必须要天火，或者火属性的奇珍异宝才能祛除那种阴煞之气。
当看到你这颗蛋带有火属性，我们说不贪婪那是假的，但是做人不能失去品质。所以我们才开口请求你帮忙。虽然我父亲看着正常，但是一到晚上那种蚀骨之痛也难以忍受。只有白天稍微好点，贪狼皇看着李天说道。
他也不知道李天会不会答应，但是也不想为难李天，更不会抢李天手中的神秘蛋。你想走随时可以走，我们贪狼一族永远是你的朋友。
说着贪狼皇递给李天一个令牌，只要在虎啸山，你持有此令牌哪里都可以去。
李天接过令牌，看着龙飞凤舞贪狼令三个字，这份量的确重。
狼叔，你可苏姨真诚待我，我也不矫情，我们先去看看，如果真的需要火属性的宝物，那我义不容辞，何况人家也救了自己，谁也不欠谁。
贪狼皇听着李天能帮忙，顿时高兴得哈哈大笑起来，我就知道，小侄一定会帮忙的。
不管成功与不成功，小天你永远是我贪狼一族的客人。外面谁欺负你，你告诉我，我派人拆了对方的家。
说着带着李天往城堡后山走去贪狼王拿出一个令牌，阵法消散。三人进入一片黝黑的洞府内，一个老者正盘膝坐着。
轻轻睁开眼睛，一副慈祥的模样。缓缓开口道，你两夫妻大白天往我这跑干嘛？打扰我老人家休养。还带一个外人来，还是一个化凡境的，这是干什么？明显眼里有怒意。
爹，我是来给你治病的，说着介绍着李天。
老人听到眼前这小家伙救了自己疼爱的乖孙，眼睛里柔和了许多。一个化凡境真的能治好你爹我吗？带着疑问的口气问着贪狼皇。
他手里有带异火的宝物你说能不能治愈。不管成功与否总得试试，那么多年折磨你的阴煞之气看着孩儿也心疼。
前辈伸出手手，别抵抗。说着李天精神力进入老者身体内，越来越皱眉，李天。骨头血肉上附有一层黑色，还有丹田也占有一点了。这是李天检查出的结果。
听到李天的回答，贪狼王希望之火又熄灭了。
这个时候苏姨问到，你怎么治不了你说说情况，女人还是比较细心的从话中能感觉到很多东西。
我检查出他的血液和血肉，骨头都覆盖着一层阴煞之气。丹田有一点，好像在慢慢侵蚀他的丹田，时间太久了，很难祛除，李天如实回答。

老者道，我就说一个化凡境小家伙怎么可能治愈这阴煞之气，好了好了，你们的孝心我感觉得到，也谢谢这位小友。治得好治不好都无所谓，那么多年都过来了。你们出去吧？老头也有些绝望的开始赶人了。
李天看着老人赶人，不是说我治不好。是实力不够，我的确是化凡境，若我能进入化神境就能治愈。
这话让三人又生起了希望，可是也有些绝望鬼知道他啥时候能进入化神境，那一丝神性也不是那么好领悟的。
就好比炼体境是炼体和吸纳灵气，筑基丹田，那化凡境就是血肉与完全融合，但是化神境就要把灵力转化为神力。这种事情难上加难，还得领悟。

Chapter 25 Treating the Father of the Greedy Wolf Emperor (Page 1)
And we found many alchemists to come and check it out. It's useless. You must use heavenly fire or rare treasures with fire attributes to get rid of the evil spirit.
When we see that your egg has the attribute of fire, we would be lying if we said you are not greedy, but you cannot lose your quality as a human being. That's why we ask for your help. Although my father looked normal, the bone-eroding pain at night was unbearable. It's only slightly better during the day, the Greedy Wolf Emperor looked at Li Tian and said.
He didn't know whether Li Tian would agree, but he didn't want to embarrass Li Tian, ​​let alone steal the mysterious egg in Li Tian's hand. You can leave anytime you want. We, the Greedy Wolf clan, will always be your friends.
As he said that, the Greedy Wolf Emperor handed Li Tian a token. As long as you are in Huxiao Mountain, you can go anywhere with this token.
Li Tian took the token and looked at the three words Greedy Wolf Order. The amount was indeed heavy.
Uncle Lang, you and Aunt Su are sincere to me. I won't be pretentious. Let's go and take a look first. If you really need a fire-attribute treasure, then I am obligated. Besides, they also saved me, so I don't owe anyone anything.
The Greedy Wolf Emperor burst out laughing when he heard that Li Tian could help. I knew that my nephew would definitely help.
Regardless of success or failure, Xiaotian, you will always be my guest of the Greedy Wolf Clan. If anyone bullies you outside, tell me and I will send people to demolish their home.
As he said that, he took Li Tian to the back hill of the castle and the Greedy Wolf King took out a token, and the formation dissipated. The three of them entered a dark cave, where an old man was sitting cross-legged.
He opened his eyes gently, with a kind look. He slowly said, "Why are you and your wife running to me in broad daylight?" Disturb my old man's recuperation. What are you doing here by bringing an outsider here, one who is in the Mortal Transformation Realm? There was obvious anger in his eyes.
Dad, I'm here to treat you, he said, introducing Li Tian.
When the old man heard that the little guy in front of him had saved his beloved grandson, his eyes softened a lot. Can a Mortal Realm really cure your father and me? He asked the Greedy Wolf Emperor in a questioning tone.
He has a treasure with strange fire in his hand. Do you think it can be cured? No matter whether you succeed or not, you have to try. The evil spirit that has tortured you for so many years makes your child feel distressed just looking at it.
Senior, please extend your hand, don’t resist. As Li Tian's mental energy entered the old man's body, he frowned more and more, Li Tian. There is a layer of black on the bones and flesh, and a little bit of the Dantian is also occupied. This is the result of Li Tian's inspection.
After hearing Li Tian's answer, Greedy Wolf King's hope went out again.
At this time, Aunt Su asked, why can't you cure the situation? Women are still more attentive and can feel a lot of things from their words.
I examined his blood and flesh, and his bones were covered with a layer of sinister aura. There is something in his Dantian that seems to be slowly eroding his Dantian. It has been taking too long and is difficult to get rid of. Li Tian answered truthfully.
The old man said, I will tell you how a little guy in the Mortal Realm can cure this evil spirit. Okay, okay, I can feel your filial piety, and thank you, little friend. It doesn't matter whether it is cured well or not, it has been here for so many years. Are you going out? The old man also started to chase people away in despair.
Li Tian looked at the old man chasing people away, not that I couldn't cure him. It's because I don't have enough strength. I am indeed in the Mortal Transformation Realm. If I can enter the Divine Transformation Realm, I can be cured.
These words gave the three of them hope again, but there were also some desperate ghosts who knew when he would enter the realm of divine transformation, and that trace of divinity was not so easy to comprehend.
Just like the body refining realm is about refining the body, absorbing spiritual energy, and building up the Dantian, the mortal transformation realm is about the complete integration of flesh and blood, but the god transformation realm is about converting spiritual power into divine power. This kind of thing is even more difficult, and you have to getEnlightenment.
